# SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3

`sheetjs-0.20.3.cjs` is the unmodified `dist/xlsx.full.min.js` bundle from the
official release https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz.

License: Apache-2.0; see `sheetjs-LICENSE` and the notices embedded in the bundle.
Used on the server to read legacy XLS and XLSX MM workbooks. No uploaded workbook
or production data is bundled with this dependency.
